Checks known advisories and compromises (OSV), SHA vs tag vs branch pinning, deprecated Node runtimes, unpinned Docker images and nested actions in action.yml, publisher and repository health. Verdict, score and fixes. Price: $0.005 in USDC per call (x402 or prepaid credits). In the free trial.
